data.standardized_narrative: For the financial year 2022, the syndicate reported a gross favourable development of claims incurred of $6.3 million for prior accident years. This release was primarily driven by favourable claims experience, particularly improvements on the 2019 year of account, although this was partially offset by deterioration on the 2017 year. The 2020 underwriting year was affected by losses from the COVID-19 pandemic, particularly in the Contingency class, but the net impact of COVID-19 losses was removed by a Loss Portfolio Transfer agreement. An unexpired risk reserve related to COVID-19 losses from the 2019 and 2020 years of account unwound in 2022, contributing to the favourable development. The syndicate also noted potential impacts from economic inflation and geopolitical events on loss costs.
